messages:
Maya L: noticed small but visible flash of other org's insight rows when rapidly switching orgs in console. repro on canary.
Rohan P: steps?
Maya L: switch org fast -> open insight preview -> preview shows previous org rows for ~1-3s before correcting. network shows old x-prefetch-key still being sent.
Jules Ops: can you share header snippet?
Maya L: snippet:
GET /api/insights/preview?org=200 200
  x-org-id: 200
  x-prefetch-key: preview:org-100:user-42  <-- stale
Response: rows(org=100)
Rohan P: sounds like prefetch key not recomputed on route change; inflight response overwrites UI store. two quick fixes: cancel inflight prefetch on nav, or server-side validate x-prefetch-key vs x-org-id and 409 if mismatch.
Jules Ops: prefer client cancel + edge guard behind FF. also want telemetry event prefetch_key_mismatch with expected/observed keys.
deploy-bot: canary snapshot infra-canary-9 -> 10% traffic.
Maya L: I'll open postmortem if needed. Rohan, can you PR client cancel and FF for edge guard? Jules, can you add telemetry + temp 100% sampling?
Rohan P: will do. toggling FF for edge guard and adding client cancel.
Jules Ops: telemetry event added. dashboard tile request submitted (Console > Isolation > Prefetch Mismatch). alert: 0.5% sustained.
Maya L: rolling monitor. thanks team.
